# gitmoap_group_catalog_scorecards (Data Source)

List the scorecards that apply to a group. Returns the group's own scorecards together with every ancestor group's, since a scorecard declared higher up applies here too; pass `include_inherited=false` for the group's own only, or `enabled_only=true` to skip disabled ones. Page with `limit` and `next_token`; a `limit` above the maximum is reduced rather than refused. Anyone who can see the group may call it.

The token needs `catalog:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_catalog_scorecards" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group's id

### Optional

- `enabled_only` (Boolean) Omit disabled scorecards
- `include_inherited` (Boolean) Include ancestor scopes' scorecards. Defaults to true, because union inheritance is what makes a baseline a baseline

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `campaign_active` (Boolean)
- `check_count` (Number)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `level_count` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `scope` (Attributes) A group or a repository, whichever a setting belongs to.

Set one of `group` or `repo`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--scope))
- `scorecard_id` (String)
- `slug` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.scope`

Read-Only:

- `group` (String)
- `repo` (String)
